sections.heading: Booleans
sections.body: Very often, in programming, you will need a data type that can only have one of two values, like: • YES / NO • ON / OFF • TRUE / FALSE For this, C has a bool data type, which is known as booleans. Booleans represent one of two values: true or false.

sections.heading: Boolean Variables
sections.body: In C, the bool type is not a built-in data type, like int or char.
